g.text: FIM measurements and their effect on field feedback

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6d828e

g.text: The 16 displayed modes are grid-orthonormal: the common deformation mode and orthogonalized low-frequency cosine fields. The projected matrix is a diagnostic, not the full operator.
Actual feedback uses the full sparse FIM. Full-image normalized FIM is the identity. No posterior covariance or SF metric is inferred from these plots.
